An overview of quiet corners at the skyport

The desk wrote this for first-time travelers
Companion Animal Travel Desk guide for cabin and checked travel

Aurelia Skyways keeps companion animal travel simple when you plan early and follow the lane the crew sets for you. Start with a clean carrier, a calm pet, and the right papers. The welcome team checks that the animal fits the travel plan and that the handoff stays smooth at the skyport.

Bring the pet in a secure carrier or crate that lets it stand, turn, and settle without strain. Keep water ready, but avoid a heavy meal right before departure. The safety coordinator reviews heat, noise, and loading risks, then pairs the trip with the right handling steps. If your animal is a large dog, <<FACT F081>>

At check-in, tell the desk about species, temperament, and any care needs. Keep the leash close and the carrier latched until a crew member gives the go-ahead. If the trip includes a large dog, <<FACT F057>>

Some travelers bring toys, a blanket, or a familiar cloth to help the animal stay settled. That small comfort can make boarding easier and reduce stress in the hold or cabin. The department also shares practical instructions with crews so the handoff stays consistent from curb to gate.

If plans change, let the Companion Animal Travel Desk know right away so we can adjust the route, the handling notes, or the loading plan. For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through Aurelia Skyways support.
